claims.citation: New York Herald, 9 May 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Ship Yorktown, Driver, London, 52 days, with mdse and
passengers, to Grinnell, Minturn & Co. Has had strong
westerly winds the entire passage; April 19, lat 42 52, lon 59
52, saw a large Can Buoy, painted black and red, with No 10
marked on it; 24th, Henry Gunnerson, seaman, died and was
buried at sea.

claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 28 May 1866, p. 3, col. 2 (British Newspaper Archive)
